description: This file defines a generic factory class 'ClientFactory' for creating client instances within the Eclipse Hono project, including methods for managing client creation requests and clearing internal state.

classes.name: ClientFactory
classes.description: A generic factory class for creating clients, managing creation requests, and handling client lifecycle state.

methods.name: clearState
methods.description: Clears all internal state and fails all pending creation requests.

methods.name: clearState (with Void parameter)
methods.description: Clears internal state, matching Handler<Void> interface, and fails all pending creation requests.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client instance asynchronously using a supplier and manages the creation request lifecycle.
